text:
Maria H.: Quick follow-up on PM-123 postmortem action items — several are past due. TL;DR the open items and owners:
- Raj P.: add RCA section to postmortem doc (due 2026-02-10) — still not merged
- Kevin L.: runbook test + update playbook (due 2026-02-12) — needs access to svc account
- Sasha R.: short-term mitigation deploy to staging (due 2026-02-11) — partial
- INF-452: infra ticket for CI runner permissions — assigned but blocked
Please drop a one-line status update here by EOD. If nothing changes by 10:00 PDT tomorrow I will escalate to Eng SRE and Eng Manager.

Raj P.: I have a draft PR for the RCA section: https://git.internal/redwood/pm-postmortems/pulls/84. Blocked on final log snippets (need infra access to pull logs from the old cluster). Raised INF-452 yesterday.

Kevin L.: I ran the runbook locally and validated steps. I can schedule a canary but I need the service-account role granted to the canary runner. @Aria S. can you approve the IAM change? I scheduled tentative window Tue 02/18 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Sasha R.: Deployed the mitigation to staging at 10:45 this morning. Smoketests passed (smoketest id: smoke-20260215-1). Still haven't promoted to prod because the canary playbook references the CI runner that lacks permissions.

Remy-bot: Reminder: 3 action items are overdue for PM-123. Please update status or mark blockers (INF-452) so we can escalate. :bell:

Aria S.: Approved the svc-account change for Kevin. I've left a note in INF-452 to move it to in_progress. @infra-team please prioritize the CI runner permission change — this is blocking multiple follow-ups.

infra-bot: INF-452 status changed -> in_progress by infra-ops. Comment: "granting runner token to canary-svc-account; target completion within 4h".

Raj P.: Thanks — I can finish the PR once I can fetch logs. If infra finishes in the window I should be able to land before EOD tomorrow.

Kevin L.: Confirming access received from infra. I will run the canary tonight and post results here. If the canary is green I'll update the runbook and push the playbook changes.

Sasha R.: I validated the canary in staging after Kevin's run — everything looks good. I'll schedule the prod rollout for 02/18 03:00 UTC and post results here.

Maria H.: Thanks all. Current plan: Raj lands doc by 02/17 EOD, Kevin finishes runbook/playbook and verifies canary tonight, Sasha promotes to prod 02/18 03:00 UTC. I'll close the PM-123 action tracker once I see the PR merged + production rollout marked done. If anything slips, ping me and I'll escalate to Eng SRE + Eng Manager. :white_check_mark:

Maria H.: Update — PR merged, canary green, prod rollout complete. Closing PM-123 remediation items and marking postmortem follow-ups resolved. Reopen if regression or outstanding tasks remain.
